name: Space Marines

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

SPACE MARINE CHAPTERS: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

armyRules.name: Hunter
armyRules.text: This profile may only be used against targets matching its Hunter keyword(s).

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.text:
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE. Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit: embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield; did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase. Effect: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. After moving: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE. Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit: embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield; did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase; that TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase. Effect: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

rules.name: Master of Wolves
rules.text:
- Your army cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any Chapter other than SPACE WOLVES.
- Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have the Master of Wolves ability:
  - Encircling Jaws: While the assault doctrine is active for this unit, this unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.
  - Hunter's Eye: While the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit's ranged attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  - Ferocious Strike: While the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, this unit's attacks that target a unit within 9" have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
- Friendly LOGAN GRIMNAR units have the following ability: Howling Onslaught (Once per battle): In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER/VEHICLE units also have the Master of Wolves ability.

abilities.text:

ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

abilities.name: Librarius
abilities.text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

SPACE MARINE CHAPTERS: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

SPACE MARINE CHAPTERS: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

abilities.text:
At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do:
- When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit. That Teleport Homer token is then removed from the battlefield.
- If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that Teleport Homer token, that Teleport Homer token is removed from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Special Move Types
abilities.text:
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE. Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit: embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield; did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase. Effect: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. After moving: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE. Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit: embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield; did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase; that TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase. Effect: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

SPACE MARINE CHAPTERS: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

abilities.text: The first time this model is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase: on a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

abilities.name: Special Move Types
abilities.text:
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE. Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit: embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield; did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase. Effect: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. After moving: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE. Set-up distance: 3". Eligible if: As stated in the rule allowing this move type, if all of the following apply to your unit: embarked within a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield; did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase; that TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase. Effect: Your unit is set up as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02). While moving: Set up each model in your unit wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
